children: ARGAN INC reported results for the quarter ended 2026 with revenue of $383.98M and diluted earnings per share of $3.76, versus $237.74M and $2.5 respectively in the prior-year quarter; net income was $53.3M compared with $35.28M a year earlier.
¹ Reported as “Revenues”. ² Reported as “Net Income”. ³ Reported as “Diluted earnings per share”.
Revenue growth was driven by Power segment project ramp-ups across multiple large EPC projects, lifting consolidated revenues roughly 56% year-to-date.
Power accounted for about 78% of revenues while Industrial increased to roughly 20%, supported by higher field services and vessel fabrication demand.
Several large projects advanced or commenced, including 1.4GW, 860MW, 700MW, 1.2GW, 1.2GW Sandow and the Tarbert biofuel project, with staggered completions through 2027–2029.
Backlog remains substantial at about $2.5B, underpinning demand amid constrained EPC capacity for dispatchable gas-fired capacity.
Teledata expanded into New England with the ValCor acquisition, adding defense and aerospace customers and regional capabilities.
